findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 7 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 21 questions numbered 1-21; by section: 7.1.3 3, 7.1.4 2, 7.1.5 4, 7.1.6 8, 7.1.7 4.
